speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin evaluating the newborn's respiratory distress, could you please describe the specific symptoms and when they first appeared after birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the premature gestation and rapid onset of respiratory distress, I suspect neonatal respiratory distress syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chest Radiograph shows fine reticular granulation with ground glass appearance on both lungs.

speaker: Doctor
text: The chest radiograph findings of reticular granulation and ground glass appearance are classic for Hyaline Membrane Disease. Given the prematurity and typical presentation, I am confident in this assessment. DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome
